_comment: Canonical MCP server definitions for Claude Code and Copilot CLI.
No literal secrets: credentials are 1Password op:// references resolved at spawn
time by `op run`. Safe to commit.
Run `ai/sync-mcp.py` to render the tool-specific config files.
`targets` selects which tools receive a server — Claude Code already gets
playwright and github via its plugin marketplace, so they are copilot-only.
Project-scoped servers live in ~/.claude.json under projects
and are deliberately not managed here; sync-mcp.py leaves that key alone.
